name: BeltTransfer
description: Pick from one belt and place on another: one state per move of the clamp carriage, four boxes.

local.name: State
local.comment: One state per move: 0 idle, 2 wait for a box, 3 lower, 4 close, 5 lift, 6 carry, 7 lower, 8 open and settle, 9 lift, 10 return, 11 finished

local.name: Settle
local.comment: A box must stand still at the blade before the clamp comes down

local.name: Rest
local.comment: A put-down box must lie still before the outfeed runs again

local.name: Lifts
local.comment: Counts the lifts at the blade: the first three bring the next box

local.name: Delivered
local.comment: Counts the boxes that passed EyeOut

inputs.name: Waiting
inputs.comment: EyePick.detect: a box waits at the stop blade of the infeed

inputs.name: OutEye
inputs.comment: EyeOut.detect: a box passes on the outfeed belt

inputs.name: XMin
inputs.comment: Pick1.xAtMin: the carriage is over the infeed

inputs.name: XMax
inputs.comment: Pick1.xAtMax: the carriage is over the outfeed

inputs.name: Gripped
inputs.comment: Pick1.gripped: the clamp holds a box

outputs.name: Emit
outputs.comment: Source1.emit: put one box on the infeed belt

outputs.name: Hold
outputs.comment: Stop1.extend: the blade holds the box while true

outputs.name: XPlus
outputs.comment: Pick1.xPlus: move toward the outfeed while true

outputs.name: XMinus
outputs.comment: Pick1.xMinus: move toward the infeed while true

outputs.name: YPlus
outputs.comment: Pick1.yPlus: lift the clamp while true

outputs.name: YMinus
outputs.comment: Pick1.yMinus: lower the clamp while true

outputs.name: Grip
outputs.comment: Pick1.grip: close the clamp while true

outputs.name: Done
outputs.comment: Beacon.green: lit when four boxes have crossed the outfeed

rungs.comment: Start: a press latches the transfer on.
Emit: one box on the infeed at the start, and the next one each time a box leaves the blade (the first three lifts).
Settle time: the box must stand still at the blade for a moment before the clamp comes down.
Rest time: after the release the box must lie still on the stopped outfeed belt before it runs again.
Count the lifts at the blade.
Count the boxes put down.
Count the boxes that pass the end of the outfeed: each rising edge of EyeOut adds one.
State 10, return: with boxes left, go back to wait for the next one.
State 10, return: after the fourth box, finish.
State 9, lift the empty clamp: when it is up, return.
State 8, open and settle: when the box lies still, lift.
State 7, lower onto the outfeed: when the clamp is down, open it and settle.
State 6, carry: when the carriage is over the outfeed, lower.
State 5, lift: when the clamp is up, carry.
State 4, close: when the clamp holds the box, lift.
State 3, lower: when the clamp is down, close it.
State 2, wait for a box: when it is still and the carriage is ready, lower.
State 0, idle: the start moves the first box in.
The infeed belt runs while the transfer is active.
The blade holds each box while the transfer is active.
The outfeed belt stands still while a box is carried over it, put down and settling.
Grip: the clamp is closed from state 4 to state 7.
YPlus: lift in states 2, 5 and 9, until the clamp is up.
YMinus: lower in states 3 and 7, until the clamp is down.
XPlus: carry toward the outfeed in state 6, until XMax.
XMinus: return toward the infeed in states 2 and 10, until XMin.
Done: lit when four boxes have passed EyeOut.
Busy: lit while the transfer runs and not yet done.
